requireSerialOnFulfillment.title: Require serial number or IMEI on fulfillment
requireSerialOnFulfillment.description: Orders containing serialized items cannot be marked packed or shipped until unit serial numbers or IMEIs are assigned.

validateImeiChecksum.title: Validate IMEI checksums
validateImeiChecksum.description: Enforce standard 15-digit Luhn algorithm verification when typing or scanning device IMEIs.

allowManualSerialEntry.title: Allow manual serial entry
allowManualSerialEntry.description: Permit staff to manually type unit numbers or IMEIs during fulfillment if not picked from pre-scanned inventory.

defaultReturnDays.title: Default return window (days)
defaultReturnDays.description: Standard return period for graded items unless overridden by a specific condition grade.

defaultWarrantyDays.title: Default warranty coverage (days)
defaultWarrantyDays.description: Standard warranty period for graded items unless overridden by a specific condition grade.

showConditionGlossary.title: Show condition glossary on storefront
showConditionGlossary.description: Publish condition grade definitions, inspection criteria, and warranty terms on product pages.
